question: Which lord is honored by repeated salutation as the master of thieves?
premises: taskarāṇām identifies thieves as the group in view
pataye designates a lord as recipient of homage
namaḥ namaḥ expresses repeated reverential salutation
inference: The repeated salutation is directed to the lord of thieves.
plain_english: Salutation, salutation to the lord of thieves.
